# Bines OS

> Bines OS is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) work-management platform: boards, groups and items with typed columns,
> views, automations, workflows, dashboards, docs, forms, interactive documents, an AI assistant and agents, a REST
> API, an MCP server for AI apps, and extensions. It runs as one Node.js process with an embedded database, or with
> Postgres and S3-compatible storage. The UI is Hebrew-first (right-to-left) with full English.

This file points AI models and coding agents to the right documentation. Paths are relative to the repository root.
On a running installation, the live API reference is at `/api/docs`, the OpenAPI document at
`/api/v1/openapi.json`, and the MCP server at `/mcp`.
